newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BankAmerica EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BankAmerica EPS view up.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison raised its earnings estimates on BankAmerica Corp to $8.55 a share from $8.40 a share in 1997 and to $9.60 a share from $9.50 a share for 1998.
-- raised the 12-month target price to $125 a share from $120 a share.
-- reiterated its buy rating on BankAmerica Corp.
-- believes the company is well-positioned for attractive longer-term annual earnings per share growth of 12 to 14 percent.
-- BankAmerica gained 1/8 to 106 in morning trading.
